label: neiso 119 anchor fuelsec
definition: neiso-119: prior keeper (2026-09-26-neiso-118-canal-ct) recipe replayed with two owner-ruled arms, one shard per year: gas_offer_margin_anchor_vintage (gas net-revenue margin identified on the solved year's own delivered gas, not the frozen 2023-2025 mean) and neiso_winter_fuelsec_conduct_roster (winter fuel-security floor limited to plants CEMS shows online in its cold-day window in other years).
